mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial slowdowns (INDPRO < 120), declining manufacturing output reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 120, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 200.0 signals high inflation that triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior three months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During strong consumer demand periods (RSAFS > 350000), rising spending for goods and services boosts corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based supply-side contraction that reduces corporate output and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
